final: WITH g AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(CAST(points_won AS REAL) / points_max) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award_vote WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), o AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall_avg FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), ov AS (SELECT overall_avg FROM o WHERE overall_avg IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.avg_ratio, g.cnt, ov.overall_avg FROM g JOIN ov ON 1 = 1 WHERE g.cnt > ov.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_kept_players, AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(cnt - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_count FROM k
